verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.usestable.com that returns HTTP 200 with a "# Stable Documentation" header. A second llms.txt is also served on the marketing site, and the docs pages are published as .md files that an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (whether it covers all API reference pages), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for agents (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
